title: Ole Talk, Kaiso & Pan
summary: Two Calypso History Month evenings pairing live steelpan with vintage calypso, extempo and soca for TT$150 per event.
description: The National Academy for the Performing Arts lists two Friday evenings by the National Steel Symphony Orchestra in the Batimamselle Room at NAPA Hotel. The 2 October programme features vintage calypso, kaiso through the decades and extempo with the Mighty Gypsy, Myron B and David Bereaux. The 9 October programme shifts to soca on steel with guest performances including Orlando Octave. Tickets are TT$150 per event and seating is limited.

validity.recurrence: Two Friday events: 2 October and 9 October 2026, 6:00 PM–10:00 PM.

sources.publisher: Island E-Tickets / National Academy for the Performing Arts

editorialNote: Ticketing page currently lists both October performances together. The listing header spans 2–9 October; the recurring description is retained rather than implying continuous operation between dates.
